name: stringpred1.k
model:
class StringPred1 {
  text:String
  prefix:String
  suffix:String
  middle:String

  req text = "Hello World"

  req prefix = "Hello"

  req suffix = "World"

  req middle = "lo Wo"
  hasPrefix:Bool

  req hasPrefix = text.startsWith(prefix)

  req hasPrefix = true
  hasSuffix:Bool

  req hasSuffix = text.endsWith(suffix)

  req hasSuffix = true
  hasMiddle:Bool

  req hasMiddle = text.contains(middle)

  req hasMiddle = true
}

main:StringPred1

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))

; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (main Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((StringPred1 (mk-StringPred1 (text String)(prefix String)(suffix String)(middle String)(hasPrefix Bool)(hasSuffix Bool)(hasMiddle Bool)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-StringPred1 (sel-StringPred1 StringPred1))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================

(define-fun const-1-StringPred1 () StringPred1

  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1))

  (let ((a!1 (str.suffixof (suffix (sel-StringPred1 (select heap 1)))
                         (text (sel-StringPred1 (select heap 1))))))
  (= (hasSuffix (sel-StringPred1 (select heap 1))) a!1)))

(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (main (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-StringPred1 a!1)))

  (= (hasSuffix (sel-StringPred1 (select heap 1))) true))
(define-fun _xkassert10 () Bool

  (= (text (sel-StringPred1 (select heap 1))) "Hello World"))
